Teach a robot hand how to explore.

Human motion guides its experiments. Every joint stays free.

About this sketch

This schematic uses a hand-drawn basis and selected synthetic samples. Both modes have equal expected total noise variance. Animation easing connects fresh, independently sampled noise. The paper learns its basis from human motion mapped to robot joints. The basis stays fixed during training.
